title: fix(app-shell): record-tabs rename gate reads the served sourceLocale
body:
Fixes #36875
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
用户能看到什么变化:搭建者在设计模式里给记录页签改名时,「能不能改名」改按应用的源语言判断,不再按部署的默认语言判断;默认语言与源语言相同的部署用户无感。
为什么做:接着菜单改名已改用源语言的那项工作,把记录页签改名补齐到同一种判断。
出错会怎样:默认语言与源语言不同的部署上,页签名可能被当成源文字写入或该能改时改不了;本改动只换判断依据,可直接撤回。
要你做什么:无

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfigIo.tsx` decided "source language" with `fetchDefaultLocale()` + `isSameLanguage(language, defaultLocale)`. It now reads the deployment's languages through the reader PR #36858 added, `fetchDeploymentLocales()`, and asks `labelLanguageOf(language, locales).source`, the exact gate the menu rename uses. That reader takes the served `sourceLocale` and falls back to the default locale when the server serves none, so the fallback is the reader's own. No second fetch: the reader is cached per page load and shared with the menu.

What the editor does with the answer is unchanged: in the source language a rename opens and writes the stored label; in any other language the rename button is disabled with the hint "Tab names are changed in the app's source language".

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordTabsConfig-36875.test.tsx`, same harness as the #36499 suite, the `GET /i18n/locales` fake now serving `sourceLocale`:

1. default locale zh-CN, source en, reader in zh-CN: rename disabled with the source-only hint, Save disabled, nothing written.
2. default locale zh-CN, source en, reader in en: rename opens, Save writes `relatedLists` `[{ list: 'contact', label: 'Contacts we know' }, 'task']` through the draft save, then publish.
3. no `sourceLocale` served: the default locale is the source, as before (zh-CN reader renames, en reader cannot).

Reverse check (one-off, no file kept): with the fix committed (`e2288d21`), `recordTabsConfigIo.tsx` was put back to `origin/main` and the new file run. Cases 1 and 2 turned red (`Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`), case 3 stayed green as expected (fallback behaviour is unchanged). Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`; HEAD blob hash matched, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance item 2 says the test "stores a tab rename as a translation". The record-tabs editor has no translation write path: outside the source language its rename is closed by design (#36499, ruling (4) precedent), it never writes a translation. The test therefore proves the side the fix controls: a reader in a default locale that is not the source language cannot write the tab name as the source label, and a reader in the source language can. Adding a translation write to record tabs would be a new capability, not this card.
- `fetchDefaultLocale` in `layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` has no caller after this change (it was the only one). Left in place: that file is the #36858 reader's and outside this card's file surface.
- The lazy-import comment in `RecordTabsConfig.tsx` (~L95) still says "the default language"; comment only, outside the file surface.
- No other design-mode rename path gates on the default locale: `git grep` for `fetchDefaultLocale` / `isSameLanguage(` under `ui/` finds only the reader itself.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordTabsConfig-36875.test.tsx` → 3 passed.

Read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfigIo.tsx` (the whole change is the gate line and the fetch it reads).

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` the three RecordTabsConfig suites + `packages/app-shell/src/layout/` → Test Files 167 passed (167), Tests 1467 passed (1467)
